Notes: Resin 3D print (or anodized aluminum for the premium version). Flat inner floor, 1.2 mm walls, pogo-pin charge pads underneath, IP54 gasket groove.
Matches the bottom shell. 30 × 5 mm slot for the LED diffuser, two 7 × 3 mm side openings for the buttons.
Frosted acrylic or clear resin. Four amber LEDs behind it read as one soft glow line, jewelry first, indicator second.

Bluetooth 5.0 microcontroller with onboard LiPo charger (BQ25101) and 5 µA sleep. Runs the button logic, BLE proximity, LEDs and motor. Sits on top of the LoRa module on 1.5 mm low-profile headers, USB-C facing up for flashing. ~$9.90 direct from Seeed.
Semtech SX1262, 862–930 MHz, 22 dBm, 1.6 µA sleep. Mounts under the XIAO on 1.5 mm low-profile headers (8 mm stack instead of the stock 21 mm). U.FL antenna connector. ~$9.90 direct from Seeed.
FPC antenna with U.FL pigtail, stuck to the inside of the lid along the back edge. Keep it 1 mm off the battery and 5 mm from the strap metal, if any. A Seeed kit antenna works for testing.
3.7 V, with protection circuit and JST connector. 36 h at the modeled 4.1 mA average. Charges in under 2 h from the XIAO’s 100 mA charger.
3 V ERM coin motor glued to the top of the battery, switched by a small MOSFET. Drives the hot/cold finding pulse and the alert patterns. Sold in 10-packs (~$8).
6 × 6 × 5 mm side-actuated tactile switch, 260 gf so it does not fire in a bag. Overmolded cap, 7 × 3 mm, flush with the shell.
Same switch with a dimpled cap so it can be told apart by touch. Hold 3 s for SOS.
Four addressable mini LEDs on a 26 mm strip of thin perfboard under the diffuser, one data pin (D7). Amber at 40% brightness reads as a soft line; LED count shows the proximity band in finding mode.
2-pin magnetic connector set with USB cable. No port to seal; the band stays splash-proof.

Notes: AO3400 (or 2N7002) N-channel MOSFET, 1N4148 flyback diode, resistors 10 kΩ ×2, 3.3 kΩ, 15 kΩ, 330 Ω, 100 Ω, 47 µF capacitor, JST-PH 2-pin. One assortment kit covers ten bands.
Waxed braided nylon with hidden elastic core so it slides over the hand. Available in colours; the pod clips to a 5 mm cord so straps are swappable.
30 AWG silicone wire, Kapton tape to insulate the battery, 1 mm foam to stop rattle, silicone gasket cord.
